System update (published: November 10, 2026 / previous: November 11, 2026)
Main change: Convenience store services for issuing family register certificates, family register supplements, and family register certificate registration applications, which were suspended due to a system failure, resumed around 4:30 PM on November 10, 2026.

【Convenience Store Services for Family Register Certificates, Family Register Supplements, and Family Register Certificate Registration Applications Now Resumed】

A system failure that began around 6:30 AM on Tuesday, November 10, 2026 (Reiwa 8) temporarily prevented access to some convenience store services.

We are pleased to inform you that the service has now resumed.

Services that were unavailable:
• Family register certificates
• Family register supplements
• Family register certificate registration applications

Outage period: From around 6:30 AM on Tuesday, November 10, 2026 (Reiwa 8) to around 4:30 PM on the same day

We apologize for any inconvenience this may have caused.

【About Convenience Store Certificate Services】

Taxation (non-taxation) and income certificates [Convenience Store Certificate Service]

Source (Japanese): https://www.city.hanno.lg.jp/soshikikarasagasu/sogoseisakubu/johosystem/13166.html
